full_details: At the Theatre, before any word came up from the river, Edith asked for a cloak and two sleeves for the autumn, payment on delivery, and no more accounts. You began on the uncertainty of the season. Kemp said the uncertainty was her point. John took the sleeves and not the cloak, at six shillings. She told him to pay her in coin and the weather in promises. You were not in Errors at two. You read that bill and went home. By dinner the lane had Billingsgate in it. The fishwives had been made to sell at their own price, and by afternoon the cry was not fish. It was strangers, Dutch and French. Verbeke came in early by the back wall with his cap in his hand. Mistress Ansell put him in the lumber garret over your chamber, with a jug and a pot, and she swore the house, you first, on her Bible. If any ask, the back room is let to a man from Norwich. Nobody came. Late, through the ceiling, he spoke of Ghent. You kept the house. You are not cast tomorrow.
one_sentence: You cut a cloak down to two sleeves at six shillings, and before dark the house swore to Norwich.
title: Six shillings, and a man from Norwich
